goal: Add a third residual stage to deepen the shared trunk, using modest 192-channel width so inference stays within the 13ms latency budget.
planned_code_changes: MnistEncoder: insert layer3 (192 channels, stride 2, 2 BasicBlocks) between layer2 and proj; proj becomes 192→64 stride 1 to preserve 64×7×7 decoder input.
ResNetTrunk: insert matching layer3 (192 ch) after layer2; former layer3 (256 ch) becomes layer4 with stride 2, output 256×4×4.
SharedLayer4MultiLinearHead: drop conv layer4; pool trunk output and apply multi-linear heads on 256-dim embedding.
EnsembleMnistCNN: wire four-stage trunk and simplified head; update test_ensemble.py param-count lock.
success_criteria: Model constructs and forward-passes on 28×28 input without shape errors.
Orchestrator eval accuracy > 0.873 inherited floor; latency_ms ≤ 13.0.
Accuracy improves over inherited 0.915 baseline if added depth yields better representations.
rollback_plan: Revert mnist/src/model.py and test_ensemble.py to polish commit 8eee6a1 state (two-stage encoder, three-stage trunk, 512-channel shared layer4 head).
